_about: Prototype (tools/): settings for the detection-resolution trial. Not used by the application.
_variants: full-res recognition = detection exactly as now (on the page shrunk to 2000 px), but each detected text line is cut from the full-resolution prepared page (300 dpi) for the classifier and recognizer, instead of from the shrunk copy. Earlier variants (detection resolution) are summarised under previous_trials.
_key_value_patterns: How the scorer finds candidate values in OCR text, to count wrong values a variant produces. Ground truth is checked by eye, not by these patterns.

previous_trials.detection_resolution_2026_09_23: current 10.2 s/page 186/194; detect-only 1600 8.1 s 186; 1280 6.5 s 182; 1024 5.4 s 182; 800 4.6 s 169; whole image 1600 8.5 s 185; whole 1280 6.7 s 183. Decision: keep current.
previous_trials.full_resolution_recognition_2026_09_23: current 10.6 s/page 186/194; full-res recognition 11.1 s/page 186/194 (recovered 2, lost 2, every page read slightly differently). No net gain; not adopted. The current misses come from faint or blurred print, not from the page shrink.

_duplicates: Byte-for-byte identical files are counted once (the first by name is kept); detected by content hash, so no file names are listed here.
